titulo.estudio: La météo du jour : Repérer les informations

intro: Interpret a simple forecast and link climate, time and recommendation. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Interpret a simple forecast and link climate, time and recommendation. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: « Il fait » describes the weather; « demain » and « l'après-midi » place the forecast. In this passage, «pluie» means «rain».

frases.estudio: Demain, le ciel sera couvert dans le nord et il fera frais.
frases.alumno: Tomorrow the sky will be cloudy in the north and it will be cool.

frases.estudio: Une pluie légère est prévue à Lille pendant la matinée.
frases.alumno: Light rain is forecast in Lille during the morning.
